title: Returned Payments and Cash-Only Status on Electric Service by Rate Schedule Accounts
content:
**Rule.** A payment to an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account that comes back unpaid — for insufficient funds, a closed account, a stop payment or a chargeback — re-bills the full original amount and adds one returned payment fee whose source is the returned payment.

**One return per payment.** Each original payment can be returned only once; a second return notice for the same original payment is not posted.

**Cash-only status.** Returns are counted over the schedule's returned-payment look-back: the calendar months ending on and including the posting date of the return being processed, that return included. When the count reaches the schedule's number of returns that triggers cash-only status, the account is placed on cash-only status, with the cash-only end date set to the posting date of that return plus the schedule's cash-only months, counted in calendar months to the same day number, falling back to the last day of the month when that day number does not exist. Automatic bank draft enrollment is ended when the account goes on cash-only status.

**Agency returns.** A returned energy assistance agency payment carries no fee and never counts toward cash-only status.

### Cash-only end dates (hypothetical returns, 12 cash-only months)

| Posting date of the triggering return | Cash-only end date |
|---|---|
| 2025-03-31 | 2026-03-31 |
| 2024-02-29 | 2025-02-28 |
| 2025-10-14 | 2026-10-14 |

### Cases (hypothetical)

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| A member's check returned for insufficient funds; it is the first return in the look-back | Original amount re-billed and one returned payment fee added; no cash-only status |
| A second return in the look-back on a schedule whose trigger is 2 returns | Re-billing and fee as above, and cash-only status from that return |
| A LIHEAP agency payment returned | Original amount re-billed; no fee; not counted toward cash-only status |
| A second return notice for a payment already returned | Not posted |
